mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and a temperature of 66 degrees, though please be aware that the air quality index is at 55.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker contest featuring designs from Verona students in grades K through 12. Community members can view the entries and vote online or at City Hall through August 7 to select the four winning designs that will be used in the November election.

Today is a busy day for events with the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory all taking place. Looking ahead, you can catch Concerts in the Park tomorrow evening.
In recent activity, on July 23, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Lucerne Drive where a 23 year old man was arrested for disorderly conduct and intimidation.
You are going to love today's flavor, which is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today so you can get your fix.
